verdict: HaloITSM: Choose HaloITSM when all-in-one per-agent ITSM with a published UK calculator is the job — not ServiceNow by default, and not Freshservice by default. Scores use the IT & Development editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: On-call adjacency in the all-in-one story
Stronger published story than SysAid quotes
weaknesses: Does not outrank ServiceNow or Freshservice
bestFor: IT teams that want an all-in-one per-agent ITSM calculator rather than edition ladders
UK/GBP buyers who will model £66 annual plus onboarding
Desks comparing HaloITSM to SysAid quotes and ManageEngine $13 Standard
notIdealFor: USD SMBs that need ManageEngine’s $13 published floor without FX conversion
tradeoffs: Per-agent vs per-host vs per-seat vs per-GB pricing models
Module stacking and consumption overages vs single-SKU floors
Free tiers vs enterprise SSO/audit gates
Landscape-adjacent tools vs primary job-cluster peers on best pages
recommendation: Choose HaloITSM when all-in-one per-agent ITSM with a published UK calculator is the job — not ServiceNow by default, and not Freshservice by default. Compare ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus for a USD $13 floor; Freshservice for the mid-market award path; SysAid if you prefer that automation suite.
editorialNotes: IT Tier-B + ITSM SMB batch. Approved on it-development-editorial v1.0.0. membershipRole=primary. jobCluster=itsm-service-desk. handsOnTesting=false. Affiliate economics excluded.

criterionAssessments.rationale: All-in-one per-agent packaging is easier to model than SysAid quotes; UK calculator is the learning tax for USD buyers. Not a lab test.
ITSM / service desk — same cluster as Freshservice and ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus, not a PSA-only or observability SKU.
All-in-one ITSM (and adjacent PSA-style) packaging is deeper out of the box than TOPdesk’s Essential → Engaged → Excellent ladder for buyers who want one SKU. Still below ServiceNow CMDB/ESM.
Slack/Teams/API cover typical desks; Halo marketplace is not Atlassian’s.
Paid all-in-one admin is solid for mid-market; not ServiceNow domain separation.
Per-agent annual ladder plus onboarding; held at 8, below ServiceNow’s 10.
Published £66/agent/mo annual calculator is clearer than SysAid quotes but sits above TOPdesk Essential £51 — GBP vs USD and onboarding extras remain the TCO catch. Affiliate economics excluded.
Halo AI assist exists — scored as supporting, not a reason to skip Freshservice or ServiceNow.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the eight IT editorial criteria using category weights (IT job fit 16, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, admin/security 12, value 12, AI 12, scalability 10), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ITSM, observability, source control, hosting panels, and web-data platforms are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
